frontmatter.title: Document Conversion

blocks.content: Aspose.Note enables programmatic conversion of Microsoft OneNote documents to other formats using Python. This workflow demonstrates how to convert `.one` files to PDF, images, or other supported formats with minimal code.

Developers can integrate note conversion into Python applications using the `aspose_note_foss` package. The library supports common output formats including PDF and image formats, making it suitable for automation, reporting, and archival workflows.

Aspose.Note enables developers to convert OneNote documents programmatically using Python. With the `aspose_note_foss` package, you can integrate robust document conversion workflows directly into your note python code, supporting formats like PDF and image files.

items: Convert OneNote (.one) files to PDF with high fidelity for professional documentation workflows
Export pages or entire notebooks to image formats (PNG, JPEG) for sharing and embedding in note python applications
Preserve document structure and formatting during conversion to ensure consistency in python note taking app outputs
Process large volumes of notes efficiently using batch conversion patterns in python note code
Integrate conversion logic into server-side or desktop tools without requiring Microsoft OneNote installation

blocks.content: To convert documents using Aspose.Note in Python, ensure you have Python 3.7 or later installed. Install the package using pip with the command `pip install aspose_note_foss`. No additional system dependencies are required.

items: aspose_note_foss package installed via `pip install aspose_note_foss`

blocks.content: Aspose.Note enables conversion of Microsoft OneNote documents to other formats using Python. With the `aspose_note_foss` package, developers can load `.one` files and save them as PDF, images, or other supported formats. This section provides minimal, runnable examples demonstrating core conversion workflows.

import aspose_note_foss

# Load a OneNote document and save as PDF
note = aspose_note_foss.Document("input.one")
note.save("output.pdf", aspose_note_foss.SaveFormat.Pdf)

When converting OneNote documents using Aspose.Note, ensure you use the correct input and output formats supported by the API. The `Document` class handles loading and saving operations, while `SaveFormat` defines target formats like PDF or image types.

items: Verify input file integrity before conversion to avoid runtime exceptions during `Document` initialization.
Use `SaveFormat.Pdf` or `SaveFormat.Image` explicitly to ensure correct output format handling.
Handle large documents by processing pages incrementally where supported, to manage memory usage efficiently.
Confirm output file accessibility after saving, especially in server environments with restricted write permissions.
